Findings of #403:
- All 19 map rows cite indexed evidence and use the correct milestone labels.
- The public typedef-impact and diagram-difference case specifications are work that the loop can do now (`benchmark/protocol.md:15,18,55,127`).
- The map omits the repetition/precision plan and the model quota (`benchmark/protocol.md:90`).

- The index hash `ccff5e0e…` and the delivery figures (`docs/research/0002-delivery.md:123,153`) are correct.

I did not submit the Owner request. #403 says to do the two specifications first. The reviewer used the GPT family, the same family as the author of #400. I record this limit.

2. `precision-quota-plan-403` (benchmark, medium, 50 min/35 turns). Expected gain: a repetition/precision plan, with the quota marked as an owner decision. Check: `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/precision_plan.py --check`.

- Saved: `.session/orders.json` (2 tasks, wake false) and the iteration 0071 section of `policy/working-memory.md`.

- After that review accepts, pin the files with a script. Then submit the corrected #403 draft as a `question` request. Update the commit and index hash in the draft first.
